name: Kawai (Nara, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kawai town emblem in white: an outlined ring of segments enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Kawai, a town in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1971.

features.role: Kawai town emblem — an outlined ring of segments enclosing a ring
